system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: yes

  vars:
    collector_port: 4317
    export_endpoint: https://your-otlp-export-endpoint.com
    service_name: opentelemetry-collector

  tasks:
  - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector
    apt:
      name: opentelemetry-collector
      state: present
    when: ansible_distribution in ["Debian", "Ubuntu"]

  - name: Install OpenTelemetry Collector (RHEL/CentOS)
    yum:
      name: opentelemetry-collector
      state: present
    when: ansible_distribution in ["RedHat", "CentOS"]

  - name: Create OpenTelemetry Collector configuration file
    template:
      src: templates/collector.yaml.j2
      dest: /etc/otel/collector.yaml
      mode: '0644'
    notify: restart collector

  - name: Enable and start OpenTelemetry Collector service
    systemd:
      name: opentelemetry-collector
      state: started
      enabled: yes

  handlers:
  - name: restart collector
    systemd:
      name: opentelemetry-collector
      state: restarted

  templates/collector.yaml.j2:
    receivers:
      otlp:
        protocol: http
        host: 0.0.0.0
        port: {{ collector_port }}
    exporters:
      otlp:
        endpoint: {{ export_endpoint }}
        insecure: false
    service:
      pipelines:
        traces:
          receivers: [otlp]
          exporters: [otlp]
